newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks fall in morning on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks fall in morning on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo stocks declined in early Wednesday morning trade as participants took profits after the key Nikkei average posted healthy gains on the previous day, brokers said.
As of 0017 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was down 159.22 points or 0.83 percent at 18,939.89. Its September futures were 220 points down at 18,880.
Brokers also said that market sentiment had grown cautious after Wall Street stocks fell on Tuesday.
